newsitem.title: NORWAY: Norway teachers serve strike notice in wage talks.
newsitem.headline: Norway teachers serve strike notice in wage talks.

text.p: Norwegian teachers said on Friday they would strike in two weeks' time unless mediation succeeds in nationwide wage talks in the public sector.
The Norwegian Academics' Union said 3,600 teachers would go on strike from May 26.
It was the first union to serve a strike notice before the mediation which will begin in earnest on May 22, with a deadline set for midnight on May 25.
The wage talks, which cover 600,000 state sector employees, broke down on April 30 with the parties making no headway on the crucial issue of early retirement.

On April 7, Norway averted a crippling strike by 250,000 workers when labour and management negotiators in the private sector accepted a mediated solution on early retirement and moderate wage increases.
A series of strikes last year hit offshore and manufacturing industries after mediators failed to bring parties together in time.
